name: Zermatt

seo.title: Zermatt ski resort guide
seo.description: A car-free village under the Matterhorn, with a ski area reaching 3,883 metres at Matterhorn Glacier Paradise.
seo.twitterDescription: Car-free, under the Matterhorn, and 3,883 m up.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, where to stay and how to get to Zermatt in Valais, Switzerland.

h1: Zermatt ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Zermatt is closed to combustion cars and reached by train from Täsch, and its ski area climbs to 3,883 metres at Matterhorn Glacier Paradise - the highest lift-served point of the eighty resorts in this project. The village itself sits at 1,608 metres under the Matterhorn.
stayOverview: The village is car-free, so everything is walked or taken by electric taxi. Winkelmatten at the southern end is quieter and closer to the Matterhorn lifts; Täsch down the valley is where the road and the car parks end.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Staying in Täsch is cheaper but adds a shuttle train at both ends of the day.
rentalCars: You cannot drive into Zermatt. The road ends at Täsch, and a shuttle train runs from there into the village.

pistes.value: 360 km across two countries, which the operator calls the highest ski area in the Alps

baseElevation.unannounced: The operator gives the 3,883 m high point and around 200 km of slopes on the Swiss side, but states no altitude for the foot of the ski area.

longestRun.unannounced: Neither the resort's snowsports pages nor the lift company's own site names a longest run.

dayPass.unannounced: The resort discounts a flex ski pass within its packages but publishes no adult day rate on the snowsports page.
